primary_null_calibration.interpretation: Conditional published-point-estimate/gene-label reference; not a biological-effect interval

no_hit_calibration.interpretation: Calibration of discovery-threshold count; not an independent negative biological test

secondary_joint_matched_test.reference: preserved nominee count per disjoint stratum, full stratum includes nominees
secondary_joint_matched_test.scope: Secondary conditional label reference; biological gene correlations unmodeled

common_universe_constant_shift.identity: (d_g-c)>(d_h-c) iff d_g>d_h; equalities are also preserved
common_universe_constant_shift.consequence: Common centering changes the reference zero/sign, not the ordering or rank enrichment in a fixed universe

experimental_uncertainty: Not estimated: published vector supplies point effects and adjusted q, not nominal p-values, covariance or complete model uncertainty. No inverse-q reconstruction attempted.
calculation_scope: All numerical results computed from the retained scientific inputs.
